name: [R19] ThinkPHP invokefunction/call_user_func_array RCE request pattern (CVE-2018-20062, CVE-2019-9082)
message:
A request matched the exploitation pattern for CVE-2018-20062 (and related CVE-2019-9082) in ThinkPHP 5.0.x/5.1.x: improper controller-name validation lets an attacker reach invokefunction with an arbitrary function name, usually chained through call_user_func_array to run eval/assert/shell-exec-style functions with attacker input (CVSS 9.8, CISA KEV). Heavily used in the wild to deploy botnet malware -- common internet background-noise scanning for any PHP-looking target.

A single hit is a lead, not proof: confirm whether this host actually runs ThinkPHP and which version (fixed in 5.0.23+), and check the response body for a reflected hash (from probes like vars[0]=md5) as a stronger signal of actual code execution.
